To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have extended the previous deployment approach to include the synthesis of technical system architectures.
we are able to automatically calculate a platform topology and its technical models which are optimized in terms of deployment of logical system model and optimization objectives.
we have developed a method to automatically synthesize the topology of technical system models and their variants from a platform independent logical system model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the automatic synthesis of technical platforms and their topology.
the synthesis of technical platform topologies, the deployment of logical models and the synthesis of technical models.
the synthesis of distributed hardware architectures for automotive embedded systems from logical system models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach is able to automatically synthesize a technical platform architecture from a logical system model and a set of constraints.
our approach is capable of automatically synthesizing technical platforms from logical system models, taking the topology into account and considering the variants of a system.
we were able to successfully demonstrate the industrial applicability of our previous work by extending the approach in order to support the synthesis of technical architectures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are able to automatically synthesize a technical platform architecture together with a deployment from a logical system model and a platform description model, taking into account optimization goals and constraints.
we were able to automatize the complete process of model based development of technical system models, from the logical system models to the technical ones, by means of model based development.
we are able to calculate a technical platform architecture which is optimized for a set of given logical models and constraints and which can be used for further development steps.
The main takeaway from our work is that
our approach can enable the automatization of the design space exploration of technical system architectures.

our approach is able to synthesize the technical platform architecture from logical models, constraints and objectives in order to achieve a platform which is optimized with respect to the deployment of logical models.
our approach enables the automatization of certain steps in the development process of distributed embedded systems and thus enables a more efficient and less error-prone development process.
